comments.author: Emma
comments.body: Your need Swahili language or African languages translation note at the part where you need to browse Biology section at Alexandria Archives.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: You need Swahili AND Arabic for this quest, not just one of them. You can use African languages translation notes for Swahili (not sure if you can use two translation notes at the same time), but the closest port that sells them is Saint-Georges.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: Hint: Chester has Swahili, so before heading to Saint-Georges for notes, check with your shipbuilding friends if anybody is nearby and could fleet with you for this step.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Don't forget Lewis and Philman, aides that also learn Swahili at the same time as Chester, and can be hired much sooner! It isn't possible to use two translation notes at the same time, either, I tried it and failed.
